method: Read current Renderer, GrowthVisuals, SceneLabels, HUD rectangle reader, RAF/HUD update order, independent-DOM readability E2E and existing immune cue tests. No source/test edits, browser launch, simulation, build or test run. Only this JSON and its companion Markdown are written by this review.

fingerprints.note: Read-time fingerprints of working-tree files, not a frozen release manifest. Root owns final freeze and runtime verification.

resolvedDuringIntegration.formerRisk: Testing label overlap only against the same cached HUD rectangles used by the production layout would permit a shared missing/misplaced-HUD error to pass.
resolvedDuringIntegration.currentResult: The E2E now independently measures ten selected actual DOM elements, requires all ten, checks each actual rectangle is covered by a production HUD rectangle, and tests placement overlap against both independent DOM rectangles and cache. This closes the original same-source blind spot for the selected normal-play HUD scope.
resolvedDuringIntegration.remainingScope: The ten elements do not include every possible temporary evolution/migration/core overlay; their dynamic combinations are outside this browser scenario. This review has not run the E2E.

resolvedDuringIntegration.formerRisk: Final opaque scene-label plates could cover actual immune-cell bodies and recent accepted-bite shape endpoints drawn earlier in the world pass.
resolvedDuringIntegration.currentResult: Renderer now reserves the visible same-organ cell silhouette using the same immuneCellBody radius and IMMUNE_BODY_LIFT. extent=radius*1.12+8 accounts for the maximum outline pulse, crawl strokes and bite arc. above=extent-IMMUNE_BODY_LIFT and below=max(12,extent+IMMUNE_BODY_LIFT) correctly describe the raised body in unsquashed CSS-like local dimensions. GrowthVisuals reserves the real selected cue.from and the two actual target-corner acknowledgements before final label layout.
resolvedDuringIntegration.coordinateCheck: Cell protection uses reserveLabelPoint and one camera scale because drawImmuneCell cancels the world .72 vertical squash before drawing its body. Bite acknowledgement uses reserveWorld because its line/corners are drawn in the original world pass and should receive .72 exactly once. No cell/event state, accepted-hit predicate, target selection or damage value is changed by these reservations.
resolvedDuringIntegration.remainingScope: Narrow endpoint protection deliberately does not reserve the entire cell-to-target segment or guarantee all details remain unobscured by unrelated DOM panels. An essential label can still report an unavoidable conflict in a dense scene. The current new E2E summons a baseline patrol and does not claim an actual protocol bite or positive bite damage.

remainingLimitations.finding: RAF renders first and then performs an approximately 20 Hz HUD update. diagnostics.labels is the last completed render result, whereas diagnostics.hudRects is the latest HUD-read snapshot and can have been refreshed after that render. If a HUD panel changes size due to dynamic text or a card, the two arrays can represent different frame generations. Current DOM overlap checks can catch a real overlap, but diagnostics alone cannot prove that both arrays were used by the exact same layout frame.
remainingLimitations.recommendation: A future diagnostic revision can retain last-render-used HUD rectangles plus a render tick/revision; browser sampling should wait for a stable subsequent render after a measured DOM change. The current short normal-HUD scenario may still be accepted as sampled evidence if its scope is kept explicit.

remainingLimitations.finding: Placement/HUD assertions apply to the before sample. The screenshot and after sample are taken later in an active run, and the after sample is recorded without repeating the tissue/squad/no-overlap assertions. The output scope correctly describes a bracketed sample; it does not establish an exact-tick image or unchanged placement throughout the bracket.
remainingLimitations.recommendation: Do not describe the image as exact-state proof. A later extension can check both bracket endpoints and stable render revisions when that precision is required.

remainingLimitations.finding: The reported low flag is inferred from the Edge project and one menu click. The test does not assert the actual resulting setting/button text. A fresh default context normally makes the assumption valid, but the flag alone is not independent proof that low effects was active.
remainingLimitations.recommendation: Keep the report clear that low is the requested project setup unless root separately verifies the actual setting. A future test can assert the public menu setting text.

remainingLimitations.finding: The new browser case checks normal-play critical HUD visibility at three viewport sizes and a real baseline patrol. It does not enter a fatal countdown, demonstrate actual protocol bite damage, stress a dense core, exercise browser zoom or DPR greater than one, measure performance, or replace human readability/fun acceptance. The E2E's written scope already excludes zoom, dense core, human readability and performance.
remainingLimitations.recommendation: Combine with separately identified unit/archived geometry evidence where relevant, without relabelling that evidence as a new live-browser or human scenario. The former small-height crisis CSS hiding rule has already been repaired and is not an open defect in this review.

verifiedBySourceInspection: SceneLabels draws after the camera world transform is restored while the CSS-pixel DPR transform remains; the reviewed path does not introduce a second .72 squash.
HUD measurements are relative to the real canvas rectangle and clipped to its CSS-pixel extent, matching the screen-label coordinate system.
HUD rectangle collection batches reads before opacity-class writes and preserves entire optional-panel rectangles while softened.
Actual interface priority is numeric descending: larger priority is more important. The earlier label-review.json rank-0 proposal is historical, not the implemented numeric contract.
Unrevealed MIMIC visibility remains guarded in battle-label collection and narrow target-feature reservations, avoiding new indirect reveal through label geometry.
The new immune reservations are presentation-only and reuse the existing accepted current-squad cue selector; no new attack is inferred from the beacon body.
excludedClaims: No browser result, final source-freeze acceptance or new test pass is asserted by this source review.
No claim that every essential label can avoid every obstacle in every dense scene; unresolved conflict is explicitly observable.
No old v074 report, raw output, runtime summary or archived artifact was modified.
No human playtest, subjective readability, gameplay fun, native acceptance, performance or absence-of-leaks claim is made.
